description: Defines the structure and function prototypes for string buffer routines in C, including buffer management, resizing, appending, and utility functions.

methods.name: strbuf_new
methods.description: Creates a new string buffer with specified initial length.

methods.name: strbuf_init
methods.description: Initializes an existing string buffer with specified length.

methods.name: strbuf_set_increment
methods.description: Sets the increment size for buffer resizing.

methods.name: strbuf_free_to_string
methods.description: Frees the buffer and returns its contents as a string.

methods.name: strbuf_resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a new length.

methods.name: strbuf_append_fmt
methods.description: Appends formatted data to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_append_fmt_retry
methods.description: Retries appending formatted data to the buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_append_string
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer.
